conclusion: Current directory traversal imposes directory-read access beyond the search access needed for a known file. Confirmed for synthetic POSIX modes on this macOS. The existing Desktop TCC wait remains unproven as a consequence of this policy.

sources.finding: openat resolves relative paths from a directory descriptor; O_SEARCH is search-only access. Search permission and requested read/write/search permission are distinct.
Directory authorization maps FREAD to read data/listing and FSEARCH to search, still through MAC open checks and vnode authorization.
Search/execute are not combined with read/write modes; fsync obtains the vnode and calls the filesystem sync operation.
Some filesystem open implementations are retried with FREAD internally, so behavior across all filesystems is not established by the local probe.

callers.uses: Metadata, absolute/relative no-follow directory traversal, temp creation, exclusive rename, cleanup.
Open/recheck sources, identity stamps, chosen export/copy destination operations. sync_all here is on the writable temporary file, not the search directory.
A single selected file uses its parent only as an implementation bound, not a reusable directory grant.
Exact authorized local webpage resources and repeated root identity checks, no directory listing API.
The file_access open helpers here are Windows-only; Unix takes a separate ordinary file-open path.
Uses independent File::open plus directory sync, not file_access::open_directory; not affected by a scoped helper change.
Likewise independent directory File::open and sync; do not sweep into this fix.

probe.note: The probe compares the syscall pattern, not production Rust entrypoints. It created/chmodded only synthetic objects under this fresh 0700 directory. All expected cases were checked against retained original stdout.

recommendation.decision: Worth a separate subsequent slice after the sixth batch, not an untested patch to frozen sources.
recommendation.minimalChange: Use macOS O_SEARCH for directory handles (including the initial / handle), keep O_NOFOLLOW/CLOEXEC and single-component traversal. Keep final file O_RDONLY/NOFOLLOW/NONBLOCK. Do not substitute O_EVTONLY or Linux O_PATH.
necessaryTests: Run the execute-only parent counterexample through actual file_access and file_delivery, preserving canonicalization/root/identity checks.
Cover local HTML directory resources and no-listing behavior, image/draft attachment checks, copy/export create/rename-no-replace/cleanup, metadata checks.
Retain intermediate and final symlink refusal, non-directory/FIFO rejection, missing search/read/write permissions, replacement identity and concurrent path-change regressions.
Check supported macOS deployment versions and additional filesystems explicitly; do not assume current SDK macros prove all-version behavior.
remaining: No Desktop/Documents TCC probe, permission reset, or system-permission change occurred.
No formal app, Agent, user file, credential or database was accessed or changed.
No production Rust/frontend source was edited for this investigation.
No evidence that O_SEARCH fixes the prior Desktop waiting symptom; final leaf access is still subject to OS authorization.
Current local fsync success is not a crash-durability or all-filesystem guarantee.
Do not introduce fallback that drops no-follow restrictions or silent permission expansion.
